463	    def _add(
464	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
465	    ) -> tuple[str, str, str | None, list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None]:
466	        order_id: str = obj["order_id"]
467	        if order_id in self._order_ids or order_id in self._reserved_order_ids:
468	            return event_id, REJECTED, DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID, [], None
469	        self._order_ids.add(order_id)
470	
471	        side: str = obj["side"]
472	        order_type: str = obj["order_type"]
473	        quantity: int = obj["quantity"]
474	        remaining: int = quantity
475	        is_iceberg = order_type == ICEBERG
476	        limit: int | None = obj["price"] if order_type in (LIMIT, ICEBERG) else None
477	        # LIMIT/ICEBERG default to GTC; MARKET keeps its historical
478	        # immediate-or-cancel semantics. MARKET with explicit GTC and ICEBERG
479	        # with any other time-in-force are rejected during schema checks.
480	        tif: str = obj.get("time_in_force") or (
481	            GTC if order_type in (LIMIT, ICEBERG) else IOC
482	        )
483	        display_quantity: int | None = (
484	            obj["display_quantity"] if is_iceberg else None
485	        )
486	        account_id: str | None = obj.get("account_id")
487	        if account_id is not None:
488	            # Any accepted ADD makes its account known, regardless of how the
489	            # order itself ends up.
490	            self._accounts.add(account_id)
491	
492	        # FOK must either match the whole quantity against the pre-event book
493	        # or do nothing at all: no trades, no book change, no trade ids spent.
494	        # The precheck walks the book in the same price-time order a real fill
495	        # would; a resting iceberg offers its full remaining quantity here,
496	        # including reserve that is not part of the visible book totals. A
497	        # same-account resting order reached before the quantity is met aborts
498	        # the event atomically, before any trade could occur.
499	        if tif == FOK:
500	            fok = self._fok_probe(side, limit, quantity, account_id)
501	            if fok is not None:
502	                record: dict[str, object] = {
503	                    "side": side,
504	                    "price": limit,
505	                    "remaining": quantity,
506	                    "status": CANCELLED,
507	                }
508	                if account_id is not None:
509	                    record["account_id"] = account_id
510	                self._orders[order_id] = record
511	                if fok is False:
512	                    return event_id, UNFILLED_CANCELLED, None, [], None
513	                stp = {
514	                    "maker_order_id": fok,
515	                    "taker_order_id": order_id,
516	                    "cancelled_quantity": quantity,
517	                }
518	                return event_id, SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED, None, [], stp
519	
520	        remaining, trades, stp_maker = self._match(
521	            event_id, order_id, side, limit, remaining, account_id
522	        )
523	
524	        record = {"side": side, "price": limit}
525	        if account_id is not None:
526	            record["account_id"] = account_id
527	        stp: dict[str, object] | None = None
528	        if stp_maker is not None:
529	            # The whole leftover is cancelled; the blocking passive order is
530	            # neither traded nor displaced, and no later liquidity is sought.
531	            result = (
532	                PARTIALLY_FILLED_SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED if trades else SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED
533	            )
534	            record["remaining"] = remaining
535	            record["status"] = CANCELLED
536	            stp = {
537	                "maker_order_id": stp_maker,
538	                "taker_order_id": order_id,
539	                "cancelled_quantity": remaining,
540	            }
541	        elif remaining == 0:
542	            result = FILLED
543	            record["remaining"] = 0
544	            record["status"] = FILLED
545	        elif order_type in (LIMIT, ICEBERG) and tif == GTC:
546	            result = PARTIALLY_FILLED_RESTING if trades else RESTING
547	            record["remaining"] = remaining
548	            record["status"] = RESTING
549	            self._rest(
550	                order_id, side, limit, remaining,
551	                display_quantity if is_iceberg else None, record,
552	            )
553	        else:
554	            # IOC leftovers never enter the book; a successful FOK is always
555	            # fully filled by construction of the pre-event availability check.
556	            result = PARTIALLY_FILLED_CANCELLED if trades else UNFILLED_CANCELLED
557	            record["remaining"] = remaining
558	            record["status"] = CANCELLED
559	
560	        self._orders[order_id] = record
561	        return event_id, result, None, trades, stp
562	
563	    def _fok_probe(
564	        self, side: str, limit: int | None, quantity: int, account_id: str | None
565	    ) -> str | bool | None:
566	        """Probe a FOK request against the pre-event book without mutating it.
567	
568	        Returns ``None`` when the whole quantity can be filled, ``False`` when
569	        liquidity runs short, or the id of the first same-account resting order
570	        reached before the quantity could be met. The walk mirrors a real fill:
571	        price-time priority across and within levels, and an exhausted iceberg
572	        slice replenishes at the tail of its level (including the hidden
573	        reserve) before the level is drained. Queues and slice sizes are copied
574	        for the simulation so the live book stays untouched.
575	        """
576	        opposite, _totals = self._opposite(side)
577	        tradable = self._tradable_fn(side, limit)
578	        need = quantity
579	        prices = sorted(opposite, reverse=side == SELL)
580	        for price in prices:
581	            if not tradable(price):
582	                continue
583	            sim_remaining: dict[str, int] = {}
584	            sim_visible: dict[str, int] = {}
585	            queue: deque[str] = deque()
586	            for maker_id in opposite[price]:
587	                maker = self._orders[maker_id]
588	                sim_remaining[maker_id] = maker["remaining"]
589	                if maker.get("visible") is not None:
590	                    sim_visible[maker_id] = maker["visible"]
591	                queue.append(maker_id)
592	            while queue and need > 0:
593	                maker_id = queue.popleft()
594	                maker = self._orders[maker_id]
595	                if account_id is not None and maker.get("account_id") == account_id:
596	                    return maker_id
597	                if maker_id in sim_visible:
598	                    available = sim_visible[maker_id]
599	                else:
600	                    available = sim_remaining[maker_id]
601	                need -= available
602	                sim_remaining[maker_id] -= available
603	                if maker_id in sim_visible:
604	                    sim_visible[maker_id] -= available
605	                    if sim_visible[maker_id] == 0 and sim_remaining[maker_id] > 0:
606	                        # The replenished slice waits behind every order already
607	                        # visible at this level, exactly as in a real fill.
608	                        sim_visible[maker_id] = min(
609	                            maker["display_quantity"], sim_remaining[maker_id]
610	                        )
611	                        queue.append(maker_id)
612	            if need <= 0:
613	                return None
614	        return False
615	
616	    def _match(
617	        self,
618	        event_id: str,
619	        order_id: str,
620	        side: str,
621	        limit: int | None,
622	        remaining: int,
623	        account_id: str | None,
624	    ) -> tuple[int, list[dict[str, object]], str | None]:
625	        """Match ``order_id`` as taker.
626	
627	        Returns its leftover, the trades already produced, and the id of the
628	        first same-account passive order reached (``None`` when matching ended
629	        normally). On a self-trade block no further liquidity is consulted and
630	        the blocking order is left exactly as it was.
631	        """
632	        opposite, totals = self._opposite(side)
633	        tradable = self._tradable_fn(side, limit)
634	
635	        trades: list[dict[str, object]] = []
636	        blocked_by: str | None = None
637	        while remaining > 0:
638	            candidates = [price for price in totals if tradable(price)]
639	            if not candidates:
640	                break
641	            price = min(candidates) if side == BUY else max(candidates)
642	            queue = opposite[price]
643	            while remaining > 0 and queue:
644	                maker_id = queue[0]
645	                maker = self._orders[maker_id]
646	                if account_id is not None and maker.get("account_id") == account_id:
647	                    # No trade, no queue/remaining/slice change; the taker
648	                    # leftover is cancelled by the caller without skipping on.
649	                    blocked_by = maker_id
650	                    return remaining, trades, blocked_by
651	                if maker.get("visible") is not None:
652	                    # A resting iceberg can only trade its current slice; the
653	                    # reserve stays hidden until the slice is exhausted.
654	                    maker_available = maker["visible"]
655	                else:
656	                    maker_available = maker["remaining"]
657	                matched = min(remaining, maker_available)
658	                maker["remaining"] -= matched
659	                remaining -= matched
660	                totals[price] -= matched
661	                trade: dict[str, object] = {
662	                    "trade_id": self._next_trade_id,
663	                    "maker_order_id": maker_id,
664	                    "taker_order_id": order_id,
665	                    "price": price,
666	                    "quantity": matched,
667	                }
668	                trades.append(trade)
669	                self._trade_log.append({**trade, "event_id": event_id})
670	                self._next_trade_id += 1
671	                if maker.get("visible") is not None:
672	                    maker["visible"] -= matched
673	                    if maker["visible"] == 0:
674	                        # The slice leaves the front immediately. With reserve
675	                        # left, the next slice joins behind every order already
676	                        # visible at this price, so this same taker may meet the
677	                        # order again after those orders.
678	                        queue.popleft()
679	                        if maker["remaining"] > 0:
680	                            new_slice = min(
681	                                maker["display_quantity"], maker["remaining"]
682	                            )
683	                            maker["visible"] = new_slice
684	                            totals[price] += new_slice
685	                            queue.append(maker_id)
686	                        else:
687	                            maker["status"] = FILLED
688	                elif maker["remaining"] == 0:
689	                    queue.popleft()
690	                    maker["status"] = FILLED
691	            if not queue:
692	                del opposite[price]
693	                del totals[price]
694	        return remaining, trades, blocked_by
695	
696	    def _rest(
697	        self,
698	        order_id: str,
699	        side: str,
700	        limit: int,
701	        remaining: int,
702	        display_quantity: int | None,
703	        record: dict[str, object],
704	    ) -> None:
705	        """Enter the leftover at the back of its price level's queue."""
706	        own_book, own_totals = self._books(side)
707	        own_book.setdefault(limit, deque()).append(order_id)
708	        if display_quantity is not None:
709	            # Only the first slice enters the book; the rest is reserve.
710	            visible = min(display_quantity, remaining)
711	            record["display_quantity"] = display_quantity
712	            record["visible"] = visible
713	        else:
714	            visible = remaining
715	        own_totals[limit] = own_totals.get(limit, 0) + visible
716	
717	    def _remove_from_book(self, order_id: str, record: dict[str, object]) -> None:
718	        """Remove a resting order's visible quantity from its price level."""
719	        own_book, own_totals = self._books(record["side"])
720	        price = record["price"]
721	        queue = own_book[price]
722	        queue.remove(order_id)
723	        # Book totals hold only the current visible slice of an iceberg; its
724	        # reserve leaves with the order but was never aggregated.
725	        visible = record.get("visible", record["remaining"])
726	        own_totals[price] -= visible
727	        if own_totals[price] == 0:
728	            del own_totals[price]
729	            del own_book[price]
730	
731	    def _replace(
732	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
733	    ) -> tuple[str, str, str | None, list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None]:
734	        order_id: str = obj["order_id"]
735	        record = self._orders.get(order_id)
736	        if record is None or record["status"] != RESTING:
737	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ORDER, [], None
738	
739	        side: str = record["side"]
740	        # The replacement trades under the target's account; the event itself
741	        # is forbidden from carrying account_id by the schema checks.
742	        account_id: str | None = record.get("account_id")
743	        is_iceberg = "display_quantity" in record
744	        display_quantity = obj.get("display_quantity")
745	        if display_quantity is None:
746	            # An omitted slice size keeps the target's original peak.
747	            display_quantity = record.get("display_quantity")
748	
749	        # Removal, matching and re-resting are one indivisible state change:
750	        # the old remainder leaves the book before the replacement arrives,
751	        # so the new order can never trade against its own previous state.
752	        self._remove_from_book(order_id, record)
753	
754	        price: int = obj["price"]
755	        remaining, trades, stp_maker = self._match(
756	            event_id, order_id, side, price, obj["quantity"], account_id
757	        )
758	
759	        new_record: dict[str, object] = {"side": side, "price": price}
760	        if account_id is not None:
761	            new_record["account_id"] = account_id
762	        stp: dict[str, object] | None = None
763	        if stp_maker is not None:
764	            # The old remainder was already removed and is not restored; the
765	            # replacement is cancelled with whatever it had left.
766	            result = (
767	                PARTIALLY_FILLED_SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED if trades else SELF_TRADE_PREVENTED
768	            )
769	            new_record["remaining"] = remaining
770	            new_record["status"] = CANCELLED
771	            stp = {
772	                "maker_order_id": stp_maker,
773	                "taker_order_id": order_id,
774	                "cancelled_quantity": remaining,
775	            }
776	        elif remaining == 0:
777	            result = FILLED
778	            new_record["remaining"] = 0
779	            new_record["status"] = FILLED
780	        else:
781	            # The replacement is a fresh GTC arrival and always rests.
782	            result = PARTIALLY_FILLED_RESTING if trades else REPLACED
783	            new_record["remaining"] = remaining
784	            new_record["status"] = RESTING
785	            self._rest(
786	                order_id, side, price, remaining,
787	                display_quantity if is_iceberg else None, new_record,
788	            )
789	
790	        # The order id stays occupied: the replacement keeps it and no later
791	        # ADD may reuse it.
792	        self._orders[order_id] = new_record
793	        return event_id, result, None, trades, stp
794	
795	    def _cancel(
796	        self, event_id: str, order_id: str
797	    ) -> tuple[str, str, str | None, list[dict[str, object]]]:
798	        record = self._orders.get(order_id)
799	        if record is None or record["status"] != RESTING:
800	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ORDER, []
801	
802	        self._remove_from_book(order_id, record)
803	        record["status"] = CANCELLED
804	        record["remaining"] = 0
805	        return event_id, CANCELLED, None, []
806	
807	    def _execution_report(
808	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
809	    ) -> tuple[
810	        str, str, str | None,
811	        list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None, dict[str, object] | None,
812	    ]:
813	        """Answer a cumulative execution query without touching any state.
814	
815	        Every trade the order ever took part in is attributed to its original
816	        ``order_id``: replacements keep the id and iceberg replenishment slices
817	        trade under the same maker id, so the journal lookup alone gathers the
818	        full history, whether the order acted as maker or taker.
819	        """
820	        order_id: str = obj["order_id"]
821	        record = self._orders.get(order_id)
822	        if record is None:
823	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ORDER, [], None, None
824	
825	        side: str = record["side"]
826	        status: str = record["status"]
827	        # A resting order's remaining total includes the iceberg reserve; a
828	        # finished order has nothing open.
829	        open_quantity = record["remaining"] if status == RESTING else 0
830	
831	        attribution: list[dict[str, object]] = []
832	        filled_quantity = 0
833	        executed_notional = 0
834	        for trade in self._trade_log:
835	            if trade["maker_order_id"] == order_id:
836	                role = MAKER
837	                counterparty = trade["taker_order_id"]
838	            elif trade["taker_order_id"] == order_id:
839	                role = TAKER
840	                counterparty = trade["maker_order_id"]
841	            else:
842	                continue
843	            filled_quantity += trade["quantity"]
844	            executed_notional += trade["price"] * trade["quantity"]
845	            attribution.append(
846	                {
847	                    "trade_id": trade["trade_id"],
848	                    "role": role,
849	                    "counterparty_order_id": counterparty,
850	                    "event_id": trade["event_id"],
851	                    "price": trade["price"],
852	                    "quantity": trade["quantity"],
853	                }
854	            )
855	
856	        if filled_quantity:
857	            vwap: dict[str, int] | None = {
858	                "numerator": executed_notional,
859	                "denominator": filled_quantity,
860	            }
861	        else:
862	            vwap = None
863	        benchmark_price: int = obj["benchmark_price"]
864	        slippage = executed_notional - benchmark_price * filled_quantity
865	        if side == SELL:
866	            # Mirror the buy formula: negative always means improvement.
867	            slippage = -slippage
868	
869	        analysis: dict[str, object] = {
870	            "side": side,
871	            "current_status": status,
872	            "open_quantity": open_quantity,
873	            "filled_quantity": filled_quantity,
874	            "executed_notional": executed_notional,
875	            "vwap": vwap,
876	            "slippage_notional": slippage,
877	            "trade_attribution": attribution,
878	        }
879	        return event_id, REPORTED, None, [], None, analysis
880	
881	    def _account_report(
882	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
883	    ) -> tuple[
884	        str, str, str | None,
885	        list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None,
886	        dict[str, object] | None, dict[str, object] | None,
887	    ]:
888	        """Answer a cumulative account query without touching any state.
889	
890	        Every trade is attributed to an account through the order it was
891	        resting or arriving as: replacements keep the order id and its
892	        account, and iceberg replenishment slices trade under the same maker
893	        id, so the journal lookup alone gathers the full history. Orders
894	        without an ``account_id`` never contribute.
895	        """
896	        account_id: str = obj["account_id"]
897	        if account_id not in self._accounts:
898	            return event_id, REJECTED, UNKNOWN_ACCOUNT, [], None, None, None
899	
900	        buy_quantity = 0
901	        sell_quantity = 0
902	        buy_notional = 0
903	        sell_notional = 0
904	        for trade in self._trade_log:
905	            for order_key in ("maker_order_id", "taker_order_id"):
906	                order = self._orders[trade[order_key]]
907	                if order.get("account_id") != account_id:
908	                    continue
909	                notional = trade["price"] * trade["quantity"]
910	                if order["side"] == BUY:
911	                    buy_quantity += trade["quantity"]
912	                    buy_notional += notional
913	                else:
914	                    sell_quantity += trade["quantity"]
915	                    sell_notional += notional
916	
917	        net_position = buy_quantity - sell_quantity
918	        if buy_quantity:
919	            buy_vwap: dict[str, int] | None = {
920	                "numerator": buy_notional,
921	                "denominator": buy_quantity,
922	            }
923	        else:
924	            buy_vwap = None
925	        if sell_quantity:
926	            sell_vwap: dict[str, int] | None = {
927	                "numerator": sell_notional,
928	                "denominator": sell_quantity,
929	            }
930	        else:
931	            sell_vwap = None
932	
933	        mark_price: int = obj["mark_price"]
934	        analysis: dict[str, object] = {
935	            "account_id": account_id,
936	            "mark_price": mark_price,
937	            "buy_quantity": buy_quantity,
938	            "sell_quantity": sell_quantity,
939	            "net_position": net_position,
940	            "buy_notional": buy_notional,
941	            "sell_notional": sell_notional,
942	            "buy_vwap": buy_vwap,
943	            "sell_vwap": sell_vwap,
944	            "turnover_notional": buy_notional + sell_notional,
945	            "risk_exposure": abs(net_position) * mark_price,
946	            "mark_to_market_pnl": (
947	                sell_notional - buy_notional + net_position * mark_price
948	            ),
949	        }
950	        return event_id, REPORTED, None, [], None, None, analysis
951	
952	    def _day_end_reconciliation(
953	        self, event_id: str, obj: dict[str, object]
954	    ) -> tuple[
955	        str, str, str | None,
956	        list[dict[str, object]], dict[str, object] | None,
957	        dict[str, object] | None, dict[str, object] | None,
958	        dict[str, object] | None,
959	    ]:
960	        """Compare the cumulative journal against external end-of-day records.
961	
962	        Purely read-only: the book, order states, queue priorities, trade
963	        journal, account set and next trade id are all left untouched. The
964	        actual side is rebuilt from the same journal the reports use, so
965	        replacements and iceberg replenishment slices contribute under their
966	        original order id and inherited account.
967	        """
968	        actual_trades: dict[int, dict[str, object]] = {}
969	        for trade in self._trade_log:
970	            actual_trades[trade["trade_id"]] = {
971	                "trade_id": trade["trade_id"],
972	                "maker_order_id": trade["maker_order_id"],
973	                "taker_order_id": trade["taker_order_id"],
974	                "price": trade["price"],
975	                "quantity": trade["quantity"],
976	            }
977	
978	        # Every account an accepted ADD ever named is part of the actual set,
979	        # whether or not it traded; cash is sell notional minus buy notional.
980	        actual_accounts: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {
981	            account_id: {
982	                "account_id": account_id,
983	                "net_position": 0,
984	                "cash_balance": 0,
985	            }
986	            for account_id in self._accounts
987	        }
988	        for trade in self._trade_log:
989	            notional = trade["price"] * trade["quantity"]
990	            for order_key in ("maker_order_id", "taker_order_id"):
991	                order = self._orders[trade[order_key]]
992	                account_id = order.get("account_id")
993	                if account_id is None:
994	                    continue
995	                position = actual_accounts[account_id]
996	                if order["side"] == BUY:
997	                    position["net_position"] += trade["quantity"]
998	                    position["cash_balance"] -= notional
999	                else:
1000	                    position["net_position"] -= trade["quantity"]
1001	                    position["cash_balance"] += notional
1002	
1003	        # The external records are normalized into the same field order the
1004	        # actual side uses, so equal content compares (and serializes) equal.
1005	        expected_trades: dict[int, dict[str, object]] = {}
1006	        for item in obj["expected_trades"]:
1007	            expected_trades[item["trade_id"]] = {
1008	                "trade_id": item["trade_id"],
1009	                "maker_order_id": item["maker_order_id"],
1010	                "taker_order_id": item["taker_order_id"],
1011	                "price": item["price"],
1012	                "quantity": item["quantity"],
1013	            }
1014	        expected_accounts: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
1015	        for item in obj["expected_accounts"]:
1016	            expected_accounts[item["account_id"]] = {
1017	                "account_id": item["account_id"],
1018	                "net_position": item["net_position"],
1019	                "cash_balance": item["cash_balance"],
1020	            }
1021	
1022	        trade_breaks = self._reconcile_breaks(expected_trades, actual_trades)
1023	        account_breaks = self._reconcile_breaks(expected_accounts, actual_accounts)
1024	        result = RECONCILED if not trade_breaks and not account_breaks else BREAKS_FOUND
1025	        reconciliation: dict[str, object] = {
1026	            "trade_breaks": trade_breaks,
1027	            "account_breaks": account_breaks,
1028	        }
1029	        return event_id, result, None, [], None, None, None, reconciliation
1030	
1031	    @staticmethod
1032	    def _reconcile_breaks(
1033	        expected: dict[object, dict[str, object]],
1034	        actual: dict[object, dict[str, object]],
1035	    ) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
1036	        """Full outer comparison of two identifier-keyed record sets.
1037	
1038	        Breaks are emitted in ascending identifier order; a record present on
1039	        only one side reports the other side as ``None``.
1040	        """
1041	        breaks: list[dict[str, object]] = []
1042	        for identifier in sorted(expected.keys() | actual.keys()):
1043	            exp = expected.get(identifier)
1044	            act = actual.get(identifier)
1045	            if exp is None:
1046	                reason = MISSING_EXPECTED
1047	            elif act is None:
1048	                reason = MISSING_ACTUAL
1049	            elif exp != act:
1050	                reason = FIELD_MISMATCH
1051	            else:
1052	                continue
1053	            breaks.append(
1054	                {
1055	                    "identifier": identifier,
1056	                    "expected": exp,
1057	                    "actual": act,
1058	                    "reason": reason,
1059	                }
1060	            )
1061	        return breaks
1062	
1063	    def snapshot(self) -> tuple[list[dict[str, int]], list[dict[str, int]]]:
1064	        bids = [
1065	            {"price": price, "quantity": self._bid_totals[price]}
1066	            for price in sorted(self._bid_totals, reverse=True)
1067	        ]
1068	        asks = [
1069	            {"price": price, "quantity": self._ask_totals[price]}
1070	            for price in sorted(self._ask_totals)
1071	        ]
1072	        return bids, asks
1073	
1074	    def has_order_id(self, order_id: str) -> bool:
1075	        """Whether an id is already spent or reserved by any accepted order."""
1076	        return order_id in self._order_ids or order_id in self._reserved_order_ids
1077	
1078	    def reserve_order_id(self, order_id: str) -> None:
1079	        """Block an id from external ADD before its derived order is submitted.
1080	
1081	        Used by parent-order plans: every future slice id is reserved when the
1082	        plan starts, so a later external ADD can never occupy it. Releasing the
1083	        slice moves the id into the regular spent-id set.
1084	        """
1085	        self._reserved_order_ids.add(order_id)
1086	
1087	    def release_order_id(self, order_id: str) -> None:
1088	        """Clear a reservation immediately before the derived order is added.
1089	
1090	        The subsequent ADD then spends the id through the regular path.
1091	        """
1092	        self._reserved_order_ids.discard(order_id)
1093	
1094	    def level_totals(self) -> tuple[dict[int, int], dict[int, int]]:
1095	        """Raw visible-quantity aggregates keyed by price (bid, then ask)."""
1096	        return self._bid_totals, self._ask_totals
1097	
1098	    def dump_state(self) -> dict[str, object]:
1099	        """Export the complete mutable engine state for an authoritative owner.
1100	
1101	        Containers are deep-copied so later processing cannot mutate the export.
1102	        The state includes enough to preserve price-time queue priority, order
1103	        remainders, iceberg slice/reserve bookkeeping, spent event/order ids,
1104	        the cumulative trade journal and the next trade id counter.
1105	        """
1106	        return {
1107	            "event_ids": set(self._event_ids),
1108	            "order_ids": set(self._order_ids),
1109	            "reserved_order_ids": set(self._reserved_order_ids),
1110	            "orders": copy.deepcopy(self._orders),
1111	            "bids": {p: deque(q) for p, q in self._bids.items()},
1112	            "asks": {p: deque(q) for p, q in self._asks.items()},
1113	            "bid_totals": dict(self._bid_totals),
1114	            "ask_totals": dict(self._ask_totals),
1115	            "next_trade_id": self._next_trade_id,
1116	            "accounts": set(self._accounts),
1117	            "trade_log": copy.deepcopy(self._trade_log),
1118	        }
1119	
1120	    def load_state(self, state: dict[str, object]) -> Engine:
1121	        """Replace this engine's whole state from an authoritative export."""
1122	        self._event_ids = set(state["event_ids"])
1123	        self._order_ids = set(state["order_ids"])
1124	        self._reserved_order_ids = set(state.get("reserved_order_ids", ()))
1125	        self._orders = copy.deepcopy(state["orders"])
1126	        self._bids = {p: deque(q) for p, q in state["bids"].items()}
1127	        self._asks = {p: deque(q) for p, q in state["asks"].items()}
1128	        self._bid_totals = dict(state["bid_totals"])
1129	        self._ask_totals = dict(state["ask_totals"])
1130	        self._next_trade_id = state["next_trade_id"]
1131	        self._accounts = set(state["accounts"])
1132	        self._trade_log = copy.deepcopy(state["trade_log"])
1133	        return self

1	"""JSON Lines event replay over standard input/output.
2	
3	Each non-empty input line is handled in order and produces one JSON object
4	on standard output. Empty lines are ignored. The program never opens any
5	files itself.
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import json
11	import sys
12	
13	from .engine import Engine
14	
15	_ERROR_IO = "ERROR_IO\n"
16	
17	
18	def _encode(payload: dict[str, object]) -> bytes:
19	    return json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
20	
21	
22	def replay(stdin: object = sys.stdin, stdout: object = sys.stdout, stderr: object = sys.stderr) -> int:
23	    """Run the replay loop. Returns the process exit code."""
24	    engine = Engine()
25	    out_parts: list[bytes] = []
26	
27	    try:
28	        raw = stdin.buffer.read()
29	        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
30	    except (OSError, UnicodeError):
31	        try:
32	            stderr.write(_ERROR_IO)
33	            stderr.flush()
34	        except OSError:
35	            pass
36	        return 1
37	
38	    for line in text.split("\n"):
39	        if line.endswith("\r"):
40	            line = line[:-1]
41	        if line == "":
42	            continue
43	
44	        event_id, result, reason, trades, stp, analysis, position, reconciliation = (
45	            engine.handle_line_reconciliation(line)
46	        )
47	        bids, asks = engine.snapshot()
48	        payload: dict[str, object] = {
49	            "input_line": line,
50	            "event_id": event_id,
51	            "result": result,
52	        }
53	        if reason is not None:
54	            payload["reason"] = reason
55	        if stp is not None:
56	            payload["self_trade_prevention"] = stp
57	        if analysis is not None:
58	            payload["execution_analysis"] = analysis
59	        if position is not None:
60	            payload["position_analysis"] = position
61	        if reconciliation is not None:
62	            payload["reconciliation"] = reconciliation
63	        payload["trades"] = trades
64	        payload["bids"] = bids
65	        payload["asks"] = asks
66	        out_parts.append(_encode(payload))
67	        out_parts.append(b"\n")
68	
69	    try:
70	        stdout.buffer.write(b"".join(out_parts))
71	        stdout.buffer.flush()
72	    except OSError:
73	        try:
74	            stderr.write(_ERROR_IO)
75	            stderr.flush()
76	        except OSError:
77	            pass
78	        return 1
79	    return 0

1	"""Deterministic multi-symbol ordered event replay with resumable snapshots.
2	
3	This module adds a new public entry point on top of the baseline single-book
4	:class:`~order_book_engine.engine.Engine`; it never changes the baseline
5	matching rules, priorities, rejection semantics or trade record shapes:
6	
7	* A single public call (:func:`replay_events`) accepts an ordered stream of
8	  order events for one or several securities. Every security keeps its own
9	  sequence counter and its own book; events are applied strictly in input
10	  order, so identical timestamps never reorder anything. The stream covers
11	  the baseline ADD/CANCEL/REPLACE behaviours and resumable TWAP parent orders
12	  (TWAP_START/TWAP_SLICE/TWAP_CANCEL/TWAP_REPORT); plans never read a wall
13	  clock and are advanced solely by TWAP_SLICE events.
14	* Each event is committed individually: a later failure never rolls back an
15	  earlier success, and a failed event leaves no order, trade, counter or book
16	  change behind.
17	* Results are plain JSON-compatible dictionaries serialized from canonical
18	  content (sorted keys, compact separators). Equal inputs always produce
19	  byte-identical output.
20	* A snapshot can be exported after any successful event and later passed back
21	  as the starting point. Snapshots carry a format version, a matching
22	  configuration summary and a SHA-256 digest over their normalized content.
23	  Resumption verifies version, configuration and digest before touching any
24	  state, and continued replay produces trade ids, trade ordering and final
25	  results identical to an uninterrupted one-shot run. Plan progress, reserved
26	  derived order ids and cumulative plan analytics are part of the snapshot.
27	
28	The module never opens files: events and snapshots are received from, and
29	returned to, the caller.
30	"""
31	
32	from __future__ import annotations
33	
34	import copy
35	import hashlib
36	import json
37	from collections import deque
38	
39	from . import __version__
40	from .engine import (
41	    ADD,
42	    BUY,
43	    CANCEL,
44	    DUPLICATE_EVENT_ID,
45	    DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID,
46	    IOC,
47	    LIMIT,
48	    MARKET,
49	    REPLACE,
50	    SELL,
51	    Engine,
52	    _is_non_empty_str,
53	    _is_positive_int,
54	)
55	
56	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
57	# Constants
58	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
59	
60	FORMAT_VERSION = "event-replay/2"
61	
62	ACCEPTED = "ACCEPTED"
63	REJECTED = "REJECTED"
64	DUPLICATE = "DUPLICATE"
65	
66	# New validation / ordering rejection codes.
67	INVALID_EVENT = "INVALID_EVENT"
68	SEQUENCE_GAP = "SEQUENCE_GAP"
69	OUT_OF_ORDER = "OUT_OF_ORDER"
70	EVENT_ID_CONFLICT = "EVENT_ID_CONFLICT"
71	
72	# TWAP parent-order rejection codes.
73	UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_PLAN = "UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_PLAN"
74	EXECUTION_PLAN_CLOSED = "EXECUTION_PLAN_CLOSED"
75	DUPLICATE_EXECUTION_PLAN = "DUPLICATE_EXECUTION_PLAN"
76	
77	# TWAP event types.
78	TWAP_START = "TWAP_START"
79	TWAP_SLICE = "TWAP_SLICE"
80	TWAP_CANCEL = "TWAP_CANCEL"
81	TWAP_REPORT = "TWAP_REPORT"
82	
83	# TWAP plan lifecycle statuses.
84	PLAN_ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
85	PLAN_COMPLETED = "COMPLETED"
86	PLAN_CANCELLED = "CANCELLED"
87	
88	# Snapshot restoration failure codes.
89	SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT = "SNAPSHOT_CORRUPT"
90	SNAPSHOT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED = "SNAPSHOT_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED"
91	CONFIG_MISMATCH = "CONFIG_MISMATCH"
92	
93	#: Event types this replay layer accepts. The TWAP parent-order commands join
94	#: the baseline mutating behaviours; the baseline read-only reports stay
95	#: exclusive to the JSON Lines entry point.
96	SUPPORTED_TYPES = frozenset(
97	    {ADD, CANCEL, REPLACE, TWAP_START, TWAP_SLICE, TWAP_CANCEL, TWAP_REPORT}
98	)
99	
100	_ENVELOPE_KEYS = frozenset({"event_id", "symbol", "sequence", "timestamp"})
101	_BASELINE_KEYS = frozenset(
102	    {"event_id", "type", "order_id", "side", "order_type", "quantity", "price",
103	     "time_in_force", "display_quantity", "account_id"}
104	)
105	_TWAP_START_KEYS = frozenset(
106	    {"event_id", "type", "plan_id", "side", "total_quantity", "slice_count",
107	     "order_type", "benchmark_price", "price", "account_id"}
108	)
109	_TWAP_START_REQUIRED = frozenset(
110	    {"event_id", "type", "plan_id", "side", "total_quantity", "slice_count",
111	     "order_type", "benchmark_price"}
112	)
113	_TWAP_PLAN_REF_KEYS = frozenset({"event_id", "type", "plan_id"})
114	_TWAP_TYPES = frozenset({TWAP_START, TWAP_SLICE, TWAP_CANCEL, TWAP_REPORT})
115	
116	
117	def _twap_schema_error(payload: dict[str, object]) -> str | None:
118	    """Structural validation of a TWAP command payload.
119	
120	    Mirrors the baseline contract: any field problem (missing or extra field,
121	    wrong type, a non-positive integer where a positive one is required, an
122	    empty identifier, a LIMIT without a positive price or a MARKET carrying
123	    one, ...) is an ``INVALID_EVENT`` and consumes neither the event id nor the
124	    sequence.
125	    """
126	    event_type = payload["type"]
127	    if event_type == TWAP_START:
128	        keys = set(payload)
129	        if not keys >= _TWAP_START_REQUIRED or not keys <= _TWAP_START_KEYS:
130	            return INVALID_EVENT
131	        if not _is_non_empty_str(payload.get("plan_id")):
132	            return INVALID_EVENT
133	        if payload.get("side") not in (BUY, SELL):
134	            return INVALID_EVENT
135	        order_type = payload.get("order_type")
136	        if order_type not in (LIMIT, MARKET):
137	            return INVALID_EVENT
138	        total_quantity = payload.get("total_quantity")
139	        slice_count = payload.get("slice_count")
140	        benchmark_price = payload.get("benchmark_price")
141	        if not _is_positive_int(total_quantity):
142	            return INVALID_EVENT
143	        if not _is_positive_int(slice_count):
144	            return INVALID_EVENT
145	        if total_quantity < slice_count:
146	            return INVALID_EVENT
147	        if not _is_positive_int(benchmark_price):
148	            return INVALID_EVENT
149	        if order_type == LIMIT:
150	            if not _is_positive_int(payload.get("price")):
151	                return INVALID_EVENT
152	        elif "price" in payload and payload["price"] is not None:
153	            # MARKET plans must not carry a non-null price; omission or an
154	            # explicit null is accepted.
155	            return INVALID_EVENT
156	        if "account_id" in payload and not _is_non_empty_str(payload.get("account_id")):
157	            return INVALID_EVENT
158	        return None
159	    # TWAP_SLICE / TWAP_CANCEL / TWAP_REPORT are pure plan references.
160	    if set(payload) != _TWAP_PLAN_REF_KEYS:
161	        return INVALID_EVENT
162	    if not _is_non_empty_str(payload.get("plan_id")):
163	        return INVALID_EVENT
164	    return None
165	
166	
167	def _valid_timestamp(value: object) -> bool:
168	    if isinstance(value, bool):
169	        return False
170	    if isinstance(value, int):
171	        return value >= 0
172	    return isinstance(value, str) and value != ""
173	
174	DEFAULT_CONFIG: dict[str, object] = {
175	    "matching_engine": "order-book-engine",
176	    "engine_version": __version__,
177	    "price_time_priority": True,
178	    "trade_id_scheme": "per_symbol_monotonic_from_1",
179	    "iceberg_replenishment": "tail_of_price_level",
180	    "self_trade_prevention": "same_account_only",
181	}
182	
183	
184	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
185	# Deterministic serialization
186	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
187	
188	
189	def canonical_json(value: object) -> bytes:
190	    """Serialize JSON content deterministically.
191	
192	    Object keys are sorted, separators are compact and no ASCII escaping is
193	    applied. Integers stay as exact JSON integers; only JSON-native content is
194	    accepted (the module never produces floats or other lossy types).
195	    """
196	    return json.dumps(
197	        value,
198	        ensure_ascii=False,
199	        sort_keys=True,
200	        separators=(",", ":"),
201	        allow_nan=False,
202	    ).encode("utf-8")
203	
204	
205	def _digest(value: object) -> str:
206	    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(value)).hexdigest()
207	
208	
209	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
210	# Snapshot restoration errors
211	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
212	
213	
214	class SnapshotError(ValueError):
215	    """A snapshot could not be restored.
216	
217	    Raising (rather than mutating and returning) guarantees that no partial
218	    recovery state is ever observable: the target replayer stays untouched.
219	    """
220	
221	    def __init__(self, code: str, message: str) -> None:
222	        super().__init__(message)
223	        self.code = code
224	
225	
226	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
227	# Replayer
228	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
229	
230	
231	class ExecutionPlan:
232	    """Mutable state of one resumable TWAP parent order on one security.
233	
234	    All cumulative analytics (filled quantity, notional, cancelled quantity)
235	    are maintained incrementally, so a snapshot carries exactly the state a
236	    continued or resumed slice needs. Slice quantities are fixed at creation:
237	    the total is divided evenly across ``slice_count`` slices and the division
238	    remainder is spread as one extra unit over the earliest slices.
239	    """
240	
241	    __slots__ = (
242	        "plan_id", "side", "order_type", "benchmark_price", "price",
243	        "account_id", "slice_quantities", "released", "released_quantity",
244	        "filled_quantity", "cancelled_quantity", "notional", "status",
245	    )
246	
247	    def __init__(
248	        self,
249	        plan_id: str,
250	        side: str,
251	        order_type: str,
252	        total_quantity: int,
253	        slice_count: int,
254	        benchmark_price: int,
255	        price: int | None,
256	        account_id: str | None,
257	    ) -> None:
258	        self.plan_id = plan_id
259	        self.side = side
260	        self.order_type = order_type
261	        self.benchmark_price = benchmark_price
262	        self.price = price
263	        self.account_id = account_id
264	        base, extra = divmod(total_quantity, slice_count)
265	        self.slice_quantities: list[int] = [
266	            base + (1 if index < extra else 0)
267	            for index in range(slice_count)
268	        ]
269	        # Number of slices already released; also the index of the next one.
270	        self.released = 0
271	        self.released_quantity = 0
272	        self.filled_quantity = 0
273	        self.cancelled_quantity = 0
274	        self.notional = 0
275	        self.status = PLAN_ACTIVE
276	
277	    @property
278	    def slice_count(self) -> int:
279	        return len(self.slice_quantities)
280	
281	    @property
282	    def total_quantity(self) -> int:
283	        return sum(self.slice_quantities)
284	
285	    @property
286	    def remaining_slices(self) -> int:
287	        if self.status != PLAN_ACTIVE:
288	            return 0
289	        return self.slice_count - self.released
290	
291	    def child_order_id(self, slice_number: int) -> str:
292	        """The deterministic derived order id of slice ``slice_number``.
293	
294	        Slice numbers are 1-based and joined with ``#``; the scheme is fixed,
295	        so the same input stream always derives the same identifiers.
296	        """
297	        return f"{self.plan_id}#{slice_number}"
298	
299	    def child_ids(self) -> list[str]:
300	        return [self.child_order_id(i + 1) for i in range(self.slice_count)]
301	
302	    def summary(
303	        self,
304	        *,
305	        slice_number: int | None = None,
306	        child_order_id: str | None = None,
307	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
308	        """Build the ``execution_plan`` object echoed by TWAP responses."""
309	        vwap = (
310	            {"numerator": self.notional, "denominator": self.filled_quantity}
311	            if self.filled_quantity
312	            else None
313	        )
314	        slippage = self.notional - self.benchmark_price * self.filled_quantity
315	        if self.side == SELL:
316	            # Mirror the buy formula: negative always means improvement.
317	            slippage = -slippage
318	        plan: dict[str, object] = {
319	            "status": self.status,
320	            "released_quantity": self.released_quantity,
321	            "filled_quantity": self.filled_quantity,
322	            "cancelled_quantity": self.cancelled_quantity,
323	            "remaining_slices": self.remaining_slices,
324	            "executed_notional": self.notional,
325	            "vwap": vwap,
326	            "slippage_notional": slippage,
327	        }
328	        if slice_number is not None:
329	            plan["slice_number"] = slice_number
330	        if child_order_id is not None:
331	            plan["child_order_id"] = child_order_id
332	        return plan
333	
334	    def to_json(self) -> dict[str, object]:
335	        """Serialize the complete plan state for a snapshot."""
336	        data: dict[str, object] = {
337	            "plan_id": self.plan_id,
338	            "side": self.side,
339	            "order_type": self.order_type,
340	            "benchmark_price": self.benchmark_price,
341	            "price": self.price,
342	            "account_id": self.account_id,
343	            "slice_quantities": list(self.slice_quantities),
344	            "released": self.released,
345	            "released_quantity": self.released_quantity,
346	            "filled_quantity": self.filled_quantity,
347	            "cancelled_quantity": self.cancelled_quantity,
348	            "notional": self.notional,
349	            "status": self.status,

369	class EventReplayer:
370	    """Stateful, resumable multi-symbol replay session.
371	
372	    One session binds together the per-symbol books, per-symbol sequence
373	    counters, the global idempotency log and the matching configuration.
374	    Instances are normally obtained from :func:`replay_events` or restored via
375	    :func:`restore_replayer`; they are not thread safe on purpose.
376	    """
377	
378	    def __init__(self, config: dict[str, object] | None = None) -> None:
379	        if config is not None and not isinstance(config, dict):
380	            raise TypeError("config must be a JSON object or None")
381	        self.config: dict[str, object] = dict(DEFAULT_CONFIG if config is None else config)
382	        self.config_digest = _digest(self.config)
383	        self._symbols: dict[str, _SymbolState] = {}
384	        # Global index of every accepted eventId: eventId -> (symbol, content).
385	        self._events: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
386	
387	    # -- book helpers -------------------------------------------------------
388	
389	    def book(self, symbol: str) -> tuple[list[dict[str, int]], list[dict[str, int]]]:
390	        """The final ``(bids, asks)`` aggregates for one security."""
391	        state = self._symbols.get(symbol)
392	        if state is None:
393	            return [], []
394	        return state.engine.snapshot()
395	
396	    # -- main entry ---------------------------------------------------------
397	
398	    def submit(self, events: list[dict[str, object]]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
399	        """Apply an ordered list of event objects, one result per event."""
400	        return [self._submit_one(event) for event in events]
401	
402	    def _book_changes(
403	        self,
404	        engine: Engine,
405	        before_bids: dict[int, int],
406	        before_asks: dict[int, int],
407	    ) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, int]]]:
408	        bid_totals, ask_totals = engine.level_totals()
409	        bid_changes: list[dict[str, int]] = []
410	        for price in sorted(set(before_bids) | set(bid_totals), reverse=True):
411	            new_qty = bid_totals.get(price, 0)
412	            if before_bids.get(price, 0) != new_qty:
413	                bid_changes.append({"price": price, "quantity": new_qty})
414	        ask_changes: list[dict[str, int]] = []
415	        for price in sorted(set(before_asks) | set(ask_totals)):
416	            new_qty = ask_totals.get(price, 0)
417	            if before_asks.get(price, 0) != new_qty:
418	                ask_changes.append({"price": price, "quantity": new_qty})
419	        return {"bids": bid_changes, "asks": ask_changes}
420	
421	    @staticmethod
422	    def _invalid(
423	        event: object,
424	        code: str = INVALID_EVENT,
425	        *,
426	        expected_sequence: int | None = None,
427	        state: _SymbolState | None = None,
428	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
429	        event_id = symbol = None
430	        sequence = None
431	        if isinstance(event, dict):
432	            eid = event.get("event_id")
433	            if isinstance(eid, str) and eid != "":
434	                event_id = eid
435	            sym = event.get("symbol")
436	            if isinstance(sym, str) and sym != "":
437	                symbol = sym
438	            seq = event.get("sequence")
439	            if isinstance(seq, int) and not isinstance(seq, bool):
440	                sequence = seq
441	        result: dict[str, object] = {
442	            "event_id": event_id,
443	            "symbol": symbol,
444	            "sequence": sequence,
445	            "status": REJECTED,
446	            "rejection_code": code,
447	        }
448	        if expected_sequence is not None:
449	            result["expected_sequence"] = expected_sequence
450	        result["trades"] = []
451	        result["book_changes"] = {"bids": [], "asks": []}
452	        if state is None:
453	            # The event references an unknown symbol, so there is no book to
454	            # echo; it also must not create the symbol on its own.
455	            result["bids"] = []
456	            result["asks"] = []
457	        else:
458	            # A pre-dispatch failure against a known symbol echoes the
459	            # untouched book, exactly like a baseline rejection does.
460	            result["bids"], result["asks"] = state.engine.snapshot()
461	        return result
462	
463	    def _submit_one(self, event: object) -> dict[str, object]:
464	        # ---- envelope validation (nothing is consumed on failure) --------
465	        if not isinstance(event, dict):
466	            return self._invalid(event)
467	        event_id = event.get("event_id")
468	        symbol = event.get("symbol")
469	        sequence = event.get("sequence")
470	        timestamp = event.get("timestamp")
471	        valid_envelope_ids = (
472	            isinstance(event_id, str)
473	            and event_id != ""
474	            and isinstance(symbol, str)
475	            and symbol != ""
476	            and isinstance(sequence, int)
477	            and not isinstance(sequence, bool)
478	            and sequence > 0
479	        )
480	        if not valid_envelope_ids:
481	            # The symbol cannot be trusted yet, so no book is echoed and no
482	            # symbol state is created.
483	            return self._invalid(event)
484	
485	        def reject_envelope(code: str = INVALID_EVENT) -> dict[str, object]:
486	            # A structurally invalid event for a recognizable symbol echoes the
487	            # untouched book but never mutates or registers anything.
488	            return self._invalid(event, code, state=self._symbols.get(symbol))
489	
490	        if "timestamp" in event and not _valid_timestamp(timestamp):
491	            return reject_envelope()
492	
493	        # The baseline payload is either nested under "event" or carried
494	        # inline alongside the envelope fields.
495	        if "event" in event:
496	            nested = event["event"]
497	            envelope_keys = _ENVELOPE_KEYS | {"event"}
498	            if not isinstance(nested, dict):
499	                return reject_envelope()
500	            payload: dict[str, object] = nested
501	            # The wrapper may only carry envelope fields plus the payload.
502	            if not set(event) <= envelope_keys:
503	                return reject_envelope()
504	        else:
505	            # The inline form may carry envelope fields plus exactly the fields
506	            # of its own payload kind.
507	            allowed_payload_keys = self._allowed_payload_keys(event.get("type"))
508	            if allowed_payload_keys is None or not set(event) <= (
509	                _ENVELOPE_KEYS | allowed_payload_keys
510	            ):
511	                return reject_envelope()
512	            # Keep event_id/type (payload fields); strip only symbol,
513	            # sequence and timestamp, which are envelope-only.
514	            payload = {
515	                key: value
516	                for key, value in event.items()
517	                if key not in ("symbol", "sequence", "timestamp")
518	            }
519	        event_type = payload.get("type")
520	        if not isinstance(event_type, str) or event_type not in SUPPORTED_TYPES:
521	            return reject_envelope()
522	        # Validate the full payload schema up front, so malformed content is
523	        # classified INVALID_EVENT and reaches neither ordering nor the book.
524	        # The wrapper and the payload must identify the same event.
525	        if payload.get("event_id") != event_id:
526	            return reject_envelope()
527	        if event_type in _TWAP_TYPES:
528	            schema_error = _twap_schema_error(payload)
529	        else:
530	            schema_error = Engine._schema_error(payload)
531	        if schema_error is not None:
532	            return reject_envelope()
533	
534	        # A symbol state is created only once the event is fully well formed;
535	        # failures that precede dispatch must not register an empty book.
536	        state = self._symbols.get(symbol)
537	        known_symbol = state is not None
538	        if state is None:
539	            state = _SymbolState()
540	
541	        # ---- global idempotency (checked before sequencing) --------------
542	        # A retried delivery carries its original, now-stale sequence; it must
543	        # still be recognized as a duplicate rather than as out-of-order.
544	        content = canonical_json(payload).decode("utf-8")
545	        prior = self._events.get(event_id)
546	        if prior is not None:
547	            prior_symbol, prior_content = prior
548	            if prior_symbol == symbol and prior_content == content:
549	                bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
550	                return {
551	                    "event_id": event_id,
552	                    "symbol": symbol,
553	                    "sequence": sequence,
554	                    "status": DUPLICATE,
555	                    "trades": [],
556	                    "book_changes": {"bids": [], "asks": []},
557	                    "bids": bids,
558	                    "asks": asks,
559	                }
560	            # Same id, different symbol or different normalized content: a
561	            # conflict consumes neither sequence nor book state, so the
562	            # correct next event can follow immediately.
563	            return self._invalid(
564	                event, EVENT_ID_CONFLICT,
565	                expected_sequence=state.last_sequence + 1 if known_symbol else None,
566	                state=state if known_symbol else None,
567	            )
568	
569	        # ---- per-symbol strict sequence ordering -------------------------
570	        expected = state.last_sequence + 1
571	        if sequence < expected or sequence > expected:
572	            code = OUT_OF_ORDER if sequence < expected else SEQUENCE_GAP
573	            return self._invalid(
574	                event, code, expected_sequence=expected,
575	                state=state if known_symbol else None,
576	            )
577	
578	        # ---- committed application ---------------------------------------
579	        # From here on the event is dispatched: register a brand new symbol
580	        # book and commit id/sequence exactly as the baseline does.
581	        if not known_symbol:
582	            self._symbols[symbol] = state
583	
584	        # A derived child id (``plan_id#slice``) is reserved from plan start;
585	        # it occupies both the order-id and event-id role of the future child,
586	        # so no external event — baseline or TWAP command — may reuse it as an
587	        # event id.
588	        if event_id in state.plan_index:
589	            # Committed like every baseline business rejection: the well-formed
590	            # event occupies its id and the sequence, but nothing else moves.
591	            state.last_sequence = sequence
592	            state.seen[event_id] = content
593	            self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
594	            bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
595	            return {
596	                "event_id": event_id,
597	                "symbol": symbol,
598	                "sequence": sequence,
599	                "status": REJECTED,
600	                "rejection_code": DUPLICATE_EVENT_ID,
601	                "trades": [],
602	                "book_changes": {"bids": [], "asks": []},
603	                "bids": bids,
604	                "asks": asks,
605	            }
606	
607	        if event_type in _TWAP_TYPES:
608	            out = self._dispatch_twap(
609	                event, payload, event_type, state, symbol, sequence, content
610	            )
611	            return out
612	
613	        before_bids, before_asks = state.engine.level_totals()
614	        before_bids = dict(before_bids)
615	        before_asks = dict(before_asks)
616	        _eid, engine_result, reason, trades, _stp, _analysis, _position = (
617	            state.engine.handle_object_position(payload)
618	        )
619	
620	        # Dispatched: the well-formed event occupies its id however the
621	        # business outcome ends, and the symbol's sequence advances exactly as
622	        # the input did. This mirrors the baseline's id-occupancy rule.
623	        state.last_sequence = sequence
624	        state.seen[event_id] = content
625	        self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
626	
627	        bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
628	        book_changes = self._book_changes(state.engine, before_bids, before_asks)
629	        if reason is None:
630	            out: dict[str, object] = {
631	                "event_id": event_id,
632	                "symbol": symbol,
633	                "sequence": sequence,
634	                "status": ACCEPTED,
635	                "result": engine_result,
636	                "trades": trades,
637	                "book_changes": book_changes,
638	                "bids": bids,
639	                "asks": asks,
640	            }
641	        else:
642	            out = {
643	                "event_id": event_id,
644	                "symbol": symbol,
645	                "sequence": sequence,
646	                "status": REJECTED,
647	                # Baseline business rejection codes (UNKNOWN_ORDER,
648	                # DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID, ...) are preserved verbatim.
649	                "rejection_code": reason,
650	                "trades": trades,
651	                "book_changes": book_changes,
652	                "bids": bids,
653	                "asks": asks,
654	            }
655	        return out
656	
657	    @staticmethod
658	    def _allowed_payload_keys(inline_type: object) -> frozenset[str] | None:
659	        """The payload fields an inline event of ``inline_type`` may carry."""
660	        if inline_type in (ADD, CANCEL, REPLACE):
661	            return _BASELINE_KEYS
662	        if inline_type == TWAP_START:
663	            return _TWAP_START_KEYS
664	        if inline_type in (TWAP_SLICE, TWAP_CANCEL, TWAP_REPORT):
665	            return _TWAP_PLAN_REF_KEYS
666	        return None
667	
668	    # -- TWAP handling ------------------------------------------------------
669	
670	    def _dispatch_twap(
671	        self,
672	        event: dict[str, object],
673	        payload: dict[str, object],
674	        event_type: str,
675	        state: _SymbolState,
676	        symbol: str,
677	        sequence: int,
678	        content: str,
679	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
680	        """Dispatch a structurally valid, in-sequence TWAP command.
681	
682	        Every branch commits the well-formed event id and advances the symbol
683	        sequence, including business rejections: this matches the baseline
684	        rule that a valid event occupies its id whatever the business result.
685	        """
686	        event_id: str = event["event_id"]
687	
688	        before_bids, before_asks = state.engine.level_totals()
689	        before_bids = dict(before_bids)
690	        before_asks = dict(before_asks)
691	
692	        if event_type == TWAP_START:
693	            result_out = self._twap_start(payload, state)
694	        elif event_type == TWAP_SLICE:
695	            result_out = self._twap_slice(payload, state)
696	        elif event_type == TWAP_CANCEL:
697	            result_out = self._twap_cancel(payload, state)
698	        else:
699	            result_out = self._twap_report(payload, state)
700	
701	        # The structurally valid TWAP command occupies its event id and the
702	        # symbol sequence whatever its business outcome.
703	        state.last_sequence = sequence
704	        state.seen[event_id] = content
705	        self._events[event_id] = (symbol, content)
706	
707	        # Only a released slice can move the book; compute the change set with
708	        # the same level-diff routine the baseline path uses, so drained
709	        # levels and iceberg replenishment are reported identically.
710	        book_changes = self._book_changes(state.engine, before_bids, before_asks)
711	        return self._twap_response(
712	            event_id, symbol, sequence, state, result_out, book_changes
713	        )
714	
715	    def _twap_start(
716	        self, payload: dict[str, object], state: _SymbolState
717	    ) -> tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, None]:
718	        """Create the plan and reserve its derived ids; no matching occurs."""
719	        plan_id: str = payload["plan_id"]
720	        if plan_id in state.plans:
721	            return REJECTED, DUPLICATE_EXECUTION_PLAN, None, None
722	        plan = ExecutionPlan(
723	            plan_id=plan_id,
724	            side=payload["side"],
725	            order_type=payload["order_type"],
726	            total_quantity=payload["total_quantity"],
727	            slice_count=payload["slice_count"],
728	            benchmark_price=payload["benchmark_price"],
729	            price=payload.get("price") if payload["order_type"] == LIMIT else None,
730	            account_id=payload.get("account_id"),
731	        )
732	        # Every derived id is reserved up front; a clash with an existing order
733	        # or another plan's derived id rejects the start before anything is
734	        # registered, so the event leaves no plan or reservation behind.
735	        for child_id in plan.child_ids():
736	            if state.engine.has_order_id(child_id) or child_id in state.plan_index:
737	                return REJECTED, DUPLICATE_ORDER_ID, None, None
738	        for child_id in plan.child_ids():
739	            state.engine.reserve_order_id(child_id)
740	            state.plan_index[child_id] = plan_id
741	        state.plans[plan_id] = plan
742	        return ACCEPTED, None, plan, None
743	
744	    def _twap_slice(
745	        self, payload: dict[str, object], state: _SymbolState
746	    ) -> tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, dict[str, object] | None]:
747	        """Release the next slice as an IOC child order against current book."""
748	        plan_id: str = payload["plan_id"]
749	        plan = state.plans.get(plan_id)
750	        if plan is None:
751	            return REJECTED, UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_PLAN, None, None
752	        if plan.status != PLAN_ACTIVE:
753	            return REJECTED, EXECUTION_PLAN_CLOSED, None, None
754	
755	        slice_number = plan.released + 1
756	        child_id = plan.child_order_id(slice_number)
757	        quantity = plan.slice_quantities[plan.released]
758	
759	        child: dict[str, object] = {
760	            "event_id": child_id,
761	            "type": ADD,
762	            "order_id": child_id,
763	            "side": plan.side,
764	            "order_type": plan.order_type,
765	            "quantity": quantity,
766	            "time_in_force": IOC,
767	        }
768	        if plan.order_type == LIMIT:
769	            child["price"] = plan.price
770	        if plan.account_id is not None:
771	            child["account_id"] = plan.account_id
772	
773	        # The child id was reserved at plan start; release it immediately
774	        # before the baseline ADD spends it through the regular path.
775	        state.engine.release_order_id(child_id)
776	        _eid, engine_result, reason, trades, _stp = state.engine.handle_object(child)
777	        # A correctly synthesized child can only fail on a programming error;
778	        # fail loudly rather than corrupt the plan counters.
779	        if reason is not None:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
780	            raise RuntimeError(f"TWAP slice child order rejected: {reason}")
781	
782	        traded_quantity = sum(trade["quantity"] for trade in trades)
783	        plan.released += 1
784	        plan.released_quantity += quantity
785	        plan.filled_quantity += traded_quantity
786	        plan.notional += sum(trade["price"] * trade["quantity"] for trade in trades)
787	        if plan.released == plan.slice_count:
788	            plan.status = PLAN_COMPLETED
789	
790	        slice_info = {
791	            "slice_number": slice_number,
792	            "child_order_id": child_id,
793	            "engine_result": engine_result,
794	            "trades": trades,
795	        }
796	        return ACCEPTED, None, plan, slice_info
797	
798	    def _twap_cancel(
799	        self, payload: dict[str, object], state: _SymbolState
800	    ) -> tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, None]:
801	        """Count the unreleased quantity as cancelled and close the plan.
802	
803	        Purely a plan-state change: no resting order is touched, no trade id
804	        or historical trade changes.
805	        """
806	        plan_id: str = payload["plan_id"]
807	        plan = state.plans.get(plan_id)
808	        if plan is None:
809	            return REJECTED, UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_PLAN, None, None
810	        if plan.status != PLAN_ACTIVE:
811	            return REJECTED, EXECUTION_PLAN_CLOSED, None, None
812	
813	        unreleased = plan.total_quantity - plan.released_quantity
814	        plan.cancelled_quantity += unreleased
815	        plan.status = PLAN_CANCELLED
816	        return ACCEPTED, None, plan, None
817	
818	    def _twap_report(
819	        self, payload: dict[str, object], state: _SymbolState
820	    ) -> tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, None]:
821	        """Read-only cumulative plan summary; closed plans stay queryable."""
822	        plan_id: str = payload["plan_id"]
823	        plan = state.plans.get(plan_id)
824	        if plan is None:
825	            return REJECTED, UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_PLAN, None, None
826	        return ACCEPTED, None, plan, None
827	
828	    @staticmethod
829	    def _twap_response(
830	        event_id: str,
831	        symbol: str,
832	        sequence: int,
833	        state: _SymbolState,
834	        result_out: tuple[str, str | None, ExecutionPlan | None, dict[str, object] | None],
835	        book_changes: dict[str, list[dict[str, int]]],
836	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
837	        """Assemble the TWAP command result, including book and plan summary."""
838	        status, code, plan, slice_info = result_out
839	        bids, asks = state.engine.snapshot()
840	        if status == ACCEPTED:
841	            if slice_info is None:
842	                # START, CANCEL and REPORT never move the book.
843	                trades: list[dict[str, object]] = []
844	                result: str | None = None
845	                slice_number = child_order_id = None
846	            else:
847	                trades = slice_info["trades"]
848	                result = slice_info["engine_result"]
849	                slice_number = slice_info["slice_number"]
850	                child_order_id = slice_info["child_order_id"]
851	            out: dict[str, object] = {
852	                "event_id": event_id,
853	                "symbol": symbol,
854	                "sequence": sequence,
855	                "status": ACCEPTED,
856	                "trades": trades,
857	                "book_changes": book_changes,
858	                "bids": bids,
859	                "asks": asks,
860	            }
861	            if result is not None:
862	                out["result"] = result
863	            out["execution_plan"] = plan.summary(
864	                slice_number=slice_number, child_order_id=child_order_id
865	            ) if plan is not None else None
866	            return out
867	        # Business rejection: the book is untouched by the command itself.
868	        return {
869	            "event_id": event_id,
870	            "symbol": symbol,
871	            "sequence": sequence,
872	            "status": REJECTED,
873	            "rejection_code": code,
874	            "trades": [],
875	            "book_changes": {"bids": [], "asks": []},
876	            "bids": bids,
877	            "asks": asks,
878	        }

1430	def export_snapshot(replayer: EventReplayer) -> dict[str, object]:
1431	    """Export a resumable, JSON-compatible snapshot of a replay session.
1432

1548	    for symbol, text in events.values():

1556	                )

1569	# Public one-call entry point

1573	def replay_events(
1574	    events: list[dict[str, object]],
1575	    config: dict[str, object] | None = None,
1576	    snapshot: dict[str, object] | None = None,
1577	    snapshot_after: object = "last",

1579	    """Replay one ordered multi-security event stream in a single public call.
1580	
1581	    Parameters
1582	    ----------
1583	    events:
1584	        Event objects in strict submission order. Each event carries
1585	        ``event_id`` (non-empty string, unique across the whole stream),
1586	        ``symbol`` (non-empty string), ``sequence`` (positive integer,
1587	        strictly increasing per symbol) and a payload — either inline
1588	        (``"type"`` plus the fields of that event kind) or nested under an
1589	        ``"event"`` object that repeats ``event_id`` and ``type``. Supported
1590	        kinds are the baseline ADD/CANCEL/REPLACE events and the TWAP
1591	        TWAP_START/TWAP_SLICE/TWAP_CANCEL/TWAP_REPORT commands.
1592	    config:

1594	        a resumed run must pass the same configuration the snapshot carries.

1623	            isinstance(snapshot_after, dict)
